items.en: The Martyrdom of St. Macarius, the Son of Basilides (Wasilides) the Minister
items.ar: أستشهاد القديس مكاريوس بن واسيليدِس الوزير

items.en: The Martyrdom of St. Leontius of Tripoli (Lawendius)

readings.en: There are many who say, "Who will show us any good?" LORD, lift up the light of Your countenance upon us. You have put gladness in my heart, More than in the season that their grain and wine increased. I will both lie down in peace, and sleep; For You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
readings.ar: كَثِيرُونَ يَقُولُونَ: «مَنْ يُرِينَا خَيْرًا؟». ٱرْفَعْ عَلَيْنَا نُورَ وَجْهِكَ يَارَبُّ. جَعَلْتَ سُرُورًا فِي قَلْبِي أَعْظَمَ مِنْ سُرُورِهِمْ إِذْ كَثُرَتْ حِنْطَتُهُمْ وَخَمْرُهُمْ. بِسَلَامَةٍ أَضْطَجِعُ بَلْ أَيْضًا أَنَامُ، لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ مُنْفَرِدًا فِي طُمَأْنِينَةٍ تُسَكِّنُنِي.

readings.en: Then Jesus said to His disciples, "If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow Me. For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it. For what profit is it to a man if he gains the whole world, and loses his own soul? Or what will a man give in exchange for his soul? For the Son of Man will come in the glory of His Father with His angels, and then He will reward each according to his works. Assuredly, I say to you, there are some standing here who shall not taste death till they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom."
readings.ar: حِينَئِذٍ قَالَ يَسُوعُ لِتَلَامِيذِهِ: «إِنْ أَرَادَ أَحَدٌ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ وَرَائِي فَلْيُنْكِرْ نَفْسَهُ وَيَحْمِلْ صَلِيبَهُ وَيَتْبَعْنِي، فَإِنَّ مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُخَلِّصَ نَفْسَهُ يُهْلِكُهَا، وَمَنْ يُهْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ مِنْ أَجْلِي يَجِدُهَا. لِأَنَّهُ مَاذَا يَنْتَفِعُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ لَوْ رَبِحَ ٱلْعَالَمَ كُلَّهُ وَخَسِرَ نَفْسَهُ؟ أَوْ مَاذَا يُعْطِي ٱلْإِنْسَانُ فِدَاءً عَنْ نَفْسِهِ؟ فَإِنَّ ٱبْنَ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ سَوْفَ يَأْتِي فِي مَجْدِ أَبِيهِ مَعَ مَلَائِكَتِهِ، وَحِينَئِذٍ يُجَازِي كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ حَسَبَ عَمَلِهِ. اَلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ: إِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْقِيَامِ هَهُنَا قَوْمًا لَا يَذُوقُونَ ٱلْمَوْتَ حَتَّى يَرَوْا ٱبْنَ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ آتِيًا فِي مَلَكُوتِهِ».

readings.en: But let all those rejoice who put their trust in You; Let them ever shout for joy, because You defend them; Let those also who love Your name Be joyful in You. For You, O LORD, will bless the righteous; With favor You will surround him as with a shield.
readings.ar: وَيَفْرَحُ جَمِيعُ ٱلْمُتَّكِلِينَ عَلَيْكَ. إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ يَهْتِفُونَ، وَتُظَلِّلُهُمْ. وَيَبْتَهِجُ بِكَ مُحِبُّو ٱسْمِكَ. لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ تُبَارِكُ ٱلصِّدِّيقَ يَارَبُّ. كَأَنَّهُ بِتُرْسٍ تُحِيطُهُ بِٱلرِّضَا.

readings.en: "Do not think that I came to bring peace on earth. I did not come to bring peace but a sword. For I have come to 'set a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law'; and 'a man's enemies will be those of his own household.' He who loves father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me. And he who loves son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me. And he who does not take his cross and follow after Me is not worthy of Me. He who finds his life will lose it, and he who loses his life for My sake will find it. "He who receives you receives Me, and he who receives Me receives Him who sent Me. He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward. And he who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward. And whoever gives one of these little ones only a cup of cold water in the name of a disciple, assuredly, I say to you, he shall by no means lose his reward."
readings.ar: «لَا تَظُنُّوا أَنِّي جِئْتُ لِأُلْقِيَ سَلَامًا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ. مَا جِئْتُ لِأُلْقِيَ سَلَامًا بَلْ سَيْفًا. فَإِنِّي جِئْتُ لِأُفَرِّقَ ٱلْإِنْسَانَ ضِدَّ أَبِيهِ، وَٱلِٱبْنَةَ ضِدَّ أُمِّهَا، وَٱلْكَنَّةَ ضِدَّ حَمَاتِهَا. وَأَعْدَاءُ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ أَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ. مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَبًا أَوْ أُمًّا أَكْثَرَ مِنِّي فَلَا يَسْتَحِقُّنِي، وَمَنْ أَحَبَّ ٱبْنًا أَوِ ٱبْنَةً أَكْثَرَ مِنِّي فَلَا يَسْتَحِقُّنِي، وَمَنْ لَا يَأْخُذُ صَلِيبَهُ وَيَتْبَعُنِي فَلَا يَسْتَحِقُّنِي. مَنْ وَجَدَ حَيَاتَهُ يُضِيعُهَا، وَمَنْ أَضَاعَ حَيَاتَهُ مِنْ أَجْلِي يَجِدُهَا. مَنْ يَقْبَلُكُمْ يَقْبَلُنِي، وَمَنْ يَقْبَلُنِي يَقْبَلُ ٱلَّذِي أَرْسَلَنِي. مَنْ يَقْبَلُ نَبِيًّا بِٱسْمِ نَبِيٍّ فَأَجْرَ نَبِيٍّ يَأْخُذُ، وَمَنْ يَقْبَلُ بَارًّا بِٱسْمِ بَارٍّ فَأَجْرَ بَارٍّ يَأْخُذُ، وَمَنْ سَقَى أَحَدَ هَؤُلَاءِ ٱلصِّغَارِ كَأْسَ مَاءٍ بَارِدٍ فَقَطْ بِٱسْمِ تِلْمِيذٍ، فَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ: إِنَّهُ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَهُ».

readings.en: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us. For the earnest expectation of the creation eagerly waits for the revealing of the sons of God. For the creation was subjected to futility, not willingly, but because of Him who subjected it in hope; because the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God. For we know that the whole creation groans and labors with birth pangs together until now. Not only that, but we also who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, eagerly waiting for the adoption, the redemption of our body. For we were saved in this hope, but hope that is seen is not hope; for why does one still hope for what he sees? But if we hope for what we do not see, we eagerly wait for it with perseverance. Likewise the Spirit also helps in our weaknesses. For we do not know what we should pray for as we ought, but the Spirit Himself makes intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered. Now He who searches the hearts knows what the mind of the Spirit is, because He makes intercession for the saints according to the will of God. And we know that all things work together for good to those who love God, to those who are the called according to His purpose. For whom He foreknew, He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son, that He might be the firstborn among many brethren. Moreover whom He predestined, these He also called; whom He called, these He also justified; and whom He justified, these He also glorified.
readings.ar: فَإِنِّي أَحْسِبُ أَنَّ آلَامَ ٱلزَّمَانِ ٱلْحَاضِرِ لَا تُقَاسُ بِٱلْمَجْدِ ٱلْعَتِيدِ أَنْ يُسْتَعْلَنَ فِينَا. لِأَنَّ ٱنْتِظَارَ ٱلْخَلِيقَةِ يَتَوَقَّعُ ٱسْتِعْلَانَ أَبْنَاءِ ٱللهِ. إِذْ أُخْضِعَتِ ٱلْخَلِيقَةُ لِلْبُطْلِ - لَيْسَ طَوْعًا، بَلْ مِنْ أَجْلِ ٱلَّذِي أَخْضَعَهَا - عَلَى ٱلرَّجَاءِ، لِأَنَّ ٱلْخَلِيقَةَ نَفْسَهَا أَيْضًا سَتُعْتَقُ مِنْ عُبُودِيَّةِ ٱلْفَسَادِ إِلَى حُرِّيَّةِ مَجْدِ أَوْلَادِ ٱللهِ. فَإِنَّنَا نَعْلَمُ أَنَّ كُلَّ ٱلْخَلِيقَةِ تَئِنُّ وَتَتَمَخَّضُ مَعًا إِلَى ٱلْآنَ. وَلَيْسَ هَكَذَا فَقَطْ، بَلْ نَحْنُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَنَا بَاكُورَةُ ٱلرُّوحِ، نَحْنُ أَنْفُسُنَا أَيْضًا نَئِنُّ فِي أَنْفُسِنَا، مُتَوَقِّعِينَ ٱلتَّبَنِّيَ فِدَاءَ أَجْسَادِنَا. لِأَنَّنَا بِٱلرَّجَاءِ خَلَصْنَا. وَلَكِنَّ ٱلرَّجَاءَ ٱلْمَنْظُورَ لَيْسَ رَجَاءً، لِأَنَّ مَا يَنْظُرُهُ أَحَدٌ كَيْفَ يَرْجُوهُ أَيْضًا؟ وَلَكِنْ إِنْ كُنَّا نَرْجُو مَا لَسْنَا نَنْظُرُهُ فَإِنَّنَا نَتَوَقَّعُهُ بِٱلصَّبْرِ. وَكَذَلِكَ ٱلرُّوحُ أَيْضًا يُعِينُ ضَعَفَاتِنَا، لِأَنَّنَا لَسْنَا نَعْلَمُ مَا نُصَلِّي لِأَجْلِهِ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي. وَلَكِنَّ ٱلرُّوحَ نَفْسَهُ يَشْفَعُ فِينَا بِأَنَّاتٍ لَا يُنْطَقُ بِهَا. وَلَكِنَّ ٱلَّذِي يَفْحَصُ ٱلْقُلُوبَ يَعْلَمُ مَا هُوَ ٱهْتِمَامُ ٱلرُّوحِ، لِأَنَّهُ بِحَسَبِ مَشِيئَةِ ٱللهِ يَشْفَعُ فِي ٱلْقِدِّيسِينَ. وَنَحْنُ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّ كُلَّ ٱلْأَشْيَاءِ تَعْمَلُ مَعًا لِلْخَيْرِ لِلَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ ٱللهَ، ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ مَدْعُوُّونَ حَسَبَ قَصْدِهِ. لِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَ فَعَرَفَهُمْ سَبَقَ فَعَيَّنَهُمْ لِيَكُونُوا مُشَابِهِينَ صُورَةَ ٱبْنِهِ، لِيَكُونَ هُوَ بِكْرًا بَيْنَ إِخْوَةٍ كَثِيرِينَ. وَٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَ فَعَيَّنَهُمْ، فَهَؤُلَاءِ دَعَاهُمْ أَيْضًا. وَٱلَّذِينَ دَعَاهُمْ، فَهَؤُلَاءِ بَرَّرَهُمْ أَيْضًا. وَٱلَّذِينَ بَرَّرَهُمْ، فَهَؤُلَاءِ مَجَّدَهُمْ أَيْضًا.

readings.en: Finally, all of you be of one mind, having compassion for one another; love as brothers, be tenderhearted, be courteous; not returning evil for evil or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing. For "He who would love life And see good days, Let him refrain his tongue from evil, And his lips from speaking deceit. Let him turn away from evil and do good; Let him seek peace and pursue it. For the eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, And His ears are open to their prayers; But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil." And who is he who will harm you if you become followers of what is good? But even if you should suffer for righteousness' sake, you are blessed. "And do not be afraid of their threats, nor be troubled." But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts, and always be ready to give a defense to everyone who asks you a reason for the hope that is in you, with meekness and fear;
readings.ar: وَٱلنِّهَايَةُ، كُونُوا جَمِيعًا مُتَّحِدِي ٱلرَّأْيِ بِحِسٍّ وَاحِدٍ، ذَوِي مَحَبَّةٍ أَخَوِيَّةٍ، مُشْفِقِينَ، لُطَفَاءَ، غَيْرَ مُجَازِينَ عَنْ شَرٍّ بِشَرٍّ أَوْ عَنْ شَتِيمَةٍ بِشَتِيمَةٍ، بَلْ بِٱلْعَكْسِ مُبَارِكِينَ، عَالِمِينَ أَنَّكُمْ لِهَذَا دُعِيتُمْ لِكَيْ تَرِثُوا بَرَكَةً. لِأَنَّ: «مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُحِبَّ ٱلْحَيَاةَ، وَيَرَى أَيَّامًا صَالِحَةً، فَلْيَكْفُفْ لِسَانَهُ عَنِ ٱلشَّرِّ، وَشَفَتَيْهِ أَنْ تَتَكَلَّمَا بِٱلْمَكْرِ، لِيُعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلشَّرِّ، وَيَصْنَعِ ٱلْخَيْرَ، لِيَطْلُبِ ٱلسَّلَامَ، وَيَجِدَّ فِي أَثَرِهِ. لِأَنَّ عَيْنَيِ ٱلرَّبِّ عَلَى ٱلْأَبْرَارِ، وَأُذْنَيْهِ إِلَى طَلِبَتِهِمْ، وَلَكِنَّ وَجْهَ ٱلرَّبِّ ضِدُّ فَاعِلِي ٱلشَّرِّ». فَمَنْ يُؤْذِيكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُتَمَثِّلِينَ بِٱلْخَيْرِ؟ وَلَكِنْ وَإِنْ تَأَلَّمْتُمْ مِنْ أَجْلِ ٱلْبِرِّ، فَطُوبَاكُمْ. وَأَمَّا خَوْفَهُمْ فَلَا تَخَافُوهُ وَلَا تَضْطَرِبُوا، بَلْ قَدِّسُوا ٱلرَّبَّ ٱلْإِلَهَ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ، مُسْتَعِدِّينَ دَائِمًا لِمُجَاوَبَةِ كُلِّ مَنْ يَسْأَلُكُمْ عَنْ سَبَبِ ٱلرَّجَاءِ ٱلَّذِي فِيكُمْ، بِوَدَاعَةٍ وَخَوْفٍ،

readings.en: And about that time there arose a great commotion about the Way. For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, who made silver shrines of Diana, brought no small profit to the craftsmen. He called them together with the workers of similar occupation, and said: "Men, you know that we have our prosperity by this trade. Moreover you see and hear that not only at Ephesus, but throughout almost all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are not gods which are made with hands. So not only is this trade of ours in danger of falling into disrepute, but also the temple of the great goddess Diana may be despised and her magnificence destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worship." Now when they heard this, they were full of wrath and cried out, saying, "Great is Diana of the Ephesians!" So the whole city was filled with confusion, and rushed into the theater with one accord, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, Macedonians, Paul's travel companions. And when Paul wanted to go in to the people, the disciples would not allow him. Then some of the officials of Asia, who were his friends, sent to him pleading that he would not venture into the theater. Some therefore cried one thing and some another, for the assembly was confused, and most of them did not know why they had come together. And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander motioned with his hand, and wanted to make his defense to the people. But when they found out that he was a Jew, all with one voice cried out for about two hours, "Great is Diana of the Ephesians!" And when the city clerk had quieted the crowd, he said: "Men of Ephesus, what man is there who does not know that the city of the Ephesians is temple guardian of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Zeus? Therefore, since these things cannot be denied, you ought to be quiet and do nothing rashly. For you have brought these men here who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess. Therefore, if Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a case against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them bring charges against one another. But if you have any other inquiry to make, it shall be determined in the lawful assembly. For we are in danger of being called in question for today's uproar, there being no reason which we may give to account for this disorderly gathering." And when he had said these things, he dismissed the assembly.
readings.ar: وَحَدَثَ فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْوَقْتِ شَغَبٌ لَيْسَ بِقَلِيلٍ بِسَبَبِ هَذَا ٱلطَّرِيقِ، لِأَنَّ إِنْسَانًا ٱسْمُهُ دِيمِتْرِيُوسُ، صَائِغٌ صَانِعُ هَيَاكِلِ فِضَّةٍ لِأَرْطَامِيسَ، كَانَ يُكَسِّبُ ٱلصُّنَّاعَ مَكْسَبًا لَيْسَ بِقَلِيلٍ. فَجَمَعَهُمْ وَٱلْفَعَلَةَ فِي مِثْلِ ذَلِكَ ٱلْعَمَلِ وَقَالَ: «أَيُّهَا ٱلرِّجَالُ أَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ سِعَتَنَا إِنَّمَا هِيَ مِنْ هَذِهِ ٱلصِّنَاعَةِ. وَأَنْتُمْ تَنْظُرُونَ وَتَسْمَعُونَ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَفَسُسَ فَقَطْ، بَلْ مِنْ جَمِيعِ أَسِيَّا تَقْرِيبًا، ٱسْتَمَالَ وَأَزَاغَ بُولُسُ هَذَا جَمْعًا كَثِيرًا قَائِلًا: إِنَّ ٱلَّتِي تُصْنَعُ بِٱلْأَيَادِي لَيْسَتْ آلِهَةً. فَلَيْسَ نَصِيبُنَا هَذَا وَحْدَهُ فِي خَطَرٍ مِنْ أَنْ يَحْصُلَ فِي إِهَانَةٍ، بَلْ أَيْضًا هَيْكَلُ أَرْطَامِيسَ، ٱلْإِلَهَةِ ٱلْعَظِيمَةِ، أَنْ يُحْسَبَ لَا شَيْءَ، وَأَنْ سَوْفَ تُهْدَمُ عَظَمَتُهَا، هِيَ ٱلَّتِي يَعْبُدُهَا جَمِيعُ أَسِيَّا وَٱلْمَسْكُونَةِ». فَلَمَّا سَمِعُوا ٱمْتَلَأُوا غَضَبًا، وَطَفِقُوا يَصْرُخُونَ قَائِلِينَ: «عَظِيمَةٌ هِيَ أَرْطَامِيسُ ٱلْأَفَسُسِيِّينَ!». فَٱمْتَلَأَتِ ٱلْمَدِينَةُ كُلُّهَا ٱضْطِرَابًا، وَٱنْدَفَعُوا بِنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ إِلَى ٱلْمَشْهَدِ خَاطِفِينَ مَعَهُمْ غَايُوسَ وَأَرِسْتَرْخُسَ ٱلْمَكِدُونِيَّيْنِ، رَفِيقَيْ بُولُسَ فِي ٱلسَّفَرِ. وَلَمَّا كَانَ بُولُسُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ بَيْنَ ٱلشَّعْبِ، لَمْ يَدَعْهُ ٱلتَّلَامِيذُ. وَأُنَاسٌ مِنْ وُجُوهِ أَسِيَّا، كَانُوا أَصْدِقَاءَهُ، أَرْسَلُوا يَطْلُبُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَنْ لَا يُسَلِّمَ نَفْسَهُ إِلَى ٱلْمَشْهَدِ. وَكَانَ ٱلْبَعْضُ يَصْرُخُونَ بِشَيْءٍ وَٱلْبَعْضُ بِشَيْءٍ آخَرَ، لِأَنَّ ٱلْمَحْفِلَ كَانَ مُضْطَرِبًا، وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَدْرُونَ لِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ كَانُوا قَدِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا! فَٱجْتَذَبُوا إِسْكَنْدَرَ مِنَ ٱلْجَمْعِ، وَكَانَ ٱلْيَهُودُ يَدْفَعُونَهُ. فَأَشَارَ إِسْكَنْدَرُ بِيَدِهِ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَحْتَجَّ لِلشَّعْبِ. فَلَمَّا عَرَفُوا أَنَّهُ يَهُودِيٌّ، صَارَ صَوْتٌ وَاحِدٌ مِنَ ٱلْجَمِيعِ صَارِخِينَ نَحْوَ مُدَّةِ سَاعَتَيْنِ: «عَظِيمَةٌ هِيَ أَرْطَامِيسُ ٱلْأَفَسُسِيِّينَ!». ثُمَّ سَكَّنَ ٱلْكَاتِبُ ٱلْجَمْعَ وَقَالَ: «أَيُّهَا ٱلرِّجَالُ ٱلْأَفَسُسِيُّونَ، مَنْ هُوَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مَدِينَةَ ٱلْأَفَسُسِيِّينَ مُتَعَبِّدَةٌ لِأَرْطَامِيسَ ٱلْإِلَهَةِ ٱلْعَظِيمَةِ وَٱلتِّمْثَالِ ٱلَّذِي هَبَطَ مِنْ زَفْسَ؟ فَإِذْ كَانَتْ هَذِهِ ٱلْأَشْيَاءُ لَا تُقَاوَمُ، يَنْبَغِي أَنْ تَكُونُوا هَادِئِينَ وَلَا تَفْعَلُوا شَيْئًا ٱقْتِحَامًا. لِأَنَّكُمْ أَتَيْتُمْ بِهَذَيْنِ ٱلرَّجُلَيْنِ، وَهُمَا لَيْسَا سَارِقَيْ هَيَاكِلَ، وَلَا مُجَدِّفَيْنِ عَلَى إِلَهَتِكُمْ. فَإِنْ كَانَ دِيمِتْرِيُوسُ وَٱلصُّنَّاعُ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُ لَهُمْ دَعْوَى عَلَى أَحَدٍ، فَإِنَّهُ تُقَامُ أَيَّامٌ لِلْقَضَاءِ، وَيُوجَدُ وُلَاةٌ، فَلْيُرَافِعُوا بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا. وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَطْلُبُونَ شَيْئًا مِنْ جِهَةِ أُمُورٍ أُخَرَ، فَإِنَّهُ يُقْضَى فِي مَحْفِلٍ شَرْعِيٍّ. لِأَنَّنَا فِي خَطَرٍ أَنْ نُحَاكَمَ مِنْ أَجْلِ فِتْنَةِ هَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ. وَلَيْسَ عِلَّةٌ يُمْكِنُنَا مِنْ أَجْلِهَا أَنْ نُقَدِّمَ حِسَابًا عَنْ هَذَا ٱلتَّجَمُّعِ». وَلَمَّا قَالَ هَذَا صَرَفَ ٱلْمَحْفِلَ.

readings.en: O God, You are more awesome than Your holy places. The God of Israel is He who gives strength and power to His people. Blessed be God! But let the righteous be glad; Let them rejoice before God; Yes, let them rejoice exceedingly.
readings.ar: مَخُوفٌ أَنْتَ يَا ٱللهُ مِنْ مَقَادِسِكَ. إِلَهُ إِسْرَائِيلَ هُوَ ٱلْمُعْطِي قُوَّةً وَشِدَّةً لِلشَّعْبِ. مُبَارَكٌ ٱللهُ! وَٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ يَفْرَحُونَ. يَبْتَهِجُونَ أَمَامَ ٱللهِ وَيَطْفِرُونَ فَرَحًا.

readings.en: "And I say to you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do. But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear Him who, after He has killed, has power to cast into hell; yes, I say to you, fear Him! "Are not five sparrows sold for two copper coins? And not one of them is forgotten before God. But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Do not fear therefore; you are of more value than many sparrows. "Also I say to you, whoever confesses Me before men, him the Son of Man also will confess before the angels of God. But he who denies Me before men will be denied before the angels of God. "And anyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but to him who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven. "Now when they bring you to the synagogues and magistrates and authorities, do not worry about how or what you should answer, or what you should say. For the Holy Spirit will teach you in that very hour what you ought to say."
readings.ar: وَلَكِنْ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ يَا أَحِبَّائِي: لَا تَخَافُوا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلْجَسَدَ، وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ أَكْثَرَ. بَلْ أُرِيكُمْ مِمَّنْ تَخَافُونَ: خَافُوا مِنَ ٱلَّذِي بَعْدَمَا يَقْتُلُ، لَهُ سُلْطَانٌ أَنْ يُلْقِيَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ. نَعَمْ، أَقُولُ لَكُمْ: مِنْ هَذَا خَافُوا! أَلَيْسَتْ خَمْسَةُ عَصَافِيرَ تُبَاعُ بِفَلْسَيْنِ، وَوَاحِدٌ مِنْهَا لَيْسَ مَنْسِيًّا أَمَامَ ٱللهِ؟ بَلْ شُعُورُ رُؤُوسِكُمْ أَيْضًا جَمِيعُهَا مُحْصَاةٌ. فَلَا تَخَافُوا! أَنْتُمْ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ عَصَافِيرَ كَثِيرَةٍ! وَأَقُولُ لَكُمْ: كُلُّ مَنِ ٱعْتَرَفَ بِي قُدَّامَ ٱلنَّاسِ، يَعْتَرِفُ بِهِ ٱبْنُ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ قُدَّامَ مَلَائِكَةِ ٱللهِ. وَمَنْ أَنْكَرَنِي قُدَّامَ ٱلنَّاسِ، يُنْكَرُ قُدَّامَ مَلَائِكَةِ ٱللهِ. وَكُلُّ مَنْ قَالَ كَلِمَةً عَلَى ٱبْنِ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ يُغْفَرُ لَهُ، وَأَمَّا مَنْ جَدَّفَ عَلَى ٱلرُّوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ فَلَا يُغْفَرُ لَهُ. وَمَتَى قَدَّمُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْمَجَامِعِ وَٱلرُّؤَسَاءِ وَٱلسَّلَاطِينِ فَلَا تَهْتَمُّوا كَيْفَ أَوْ بِمَا تَحْتَجُّونَ أَوْ بِمَا تَقُولُونَ، لِأَنَّ ٱلرُّوحَ ٱلْقُدُسَ يُعَلِّمُكُمْ فِي تِلْكَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مَا يَجِبُ أَنْ تَقُولُوهُ».

days.intro_en:
Vespers Psalm (read at the evening prayer service) (Psalm 4:6–8): Here David speaks to the people, telling them that the Lord hears the godly, and prays to God who gives him peace and gladness.
Vespers Gospel (Matthew 16:24–28): Here the Lord Jesus tells His disciples that whoever loses his life for His sake will find it, for what profit is it to gain the whole world and lose one's soul?
Matins Psalm (read at the morning prayer service) (Psalm 5:11–12): Here David prays to the Lord in the morning, asking Him to lead him in righteousness and to bless all who trust in Him.
Matins Gospel (Matthew 10:34–42): Here the Lord Jesus tells His apostles that He brings a sword, that they must take up their cross, and that whoever receives them receives Him.
Pauline Epistle (a letter written by St Paul) (Romans 8:18–30): Here St Paul tells the Christians in Rome that present sufferings cannot compare with the glory to come, and that all things work together for good to those who love God.
Catholic Epistle (a letter to all churches by James, Peter, John or Jude) (1 Peter 3:8–15): Here St Peter tells the Christians to be of one mind, to bless instead of retaliating, and to be ready to explain their hope with meekness (gentle humility).
Praxis (the reading from the Acts of the Apostles) (Acts 19:23–41): Here St Luke tells how the riot in Ephesus over Artemis is calmed by the town clerk, who dismisses the assembly.
Liturgy Psalm (read at the Liturgy, the service of Holy Communion) (Psalm 68:35,3): Here David calls on God to arise, praises Him who rides in triumph and ascends on high, and calls the kingdoms of the earth to sing to Him.
Liturgy Gospel (Luke 12:4–12): Here the Lord Jesus tells His friends not to fear those who kill the body, to confess Him before people, and to trust the Holy Spirit.
days.intro_ar:
مزمور العشية (مزامير 4: 6–8): هنا يكلّم داود النبيّ الشعب قائلًا إنّ الربّ يسمع للتقيّ، ويصلّي إلى الله الذي يعطيه السلام والفرح.
إنجيل العشية (متى 16: 24–28): هنا يقول الربّ يسوع لتلاميذه إنّ من يهلك نفسه من أجله يجدها، فماذا ينتفع الإنسان لو ربح العالم كلّه وخسر نفسه؟
مزمور باكر (مزامير 5: 11–12): هنا يصلّي داود النبيّ إلى الربّ في الصباح، طالبًا أن يهديه في برّه وأن يبارك كلّ المتّكلين عليه.
إنجيل باكر (متى 10: 34–42): هنا يقول الربّ يسوع لرسله إنّه جاء ليُلقي سيفًا، وإنّ عليهم أن يحملوا صليبهم، وإنّ من يقبلهم يقبله.
البولس (رسالة من رسائل القدّيس بولس) (رومية 8: 18–30): هنا يقول القدّيس بولس لأهل رومية إنّ آلام الزمان الحاضر لا تُقاس بالمجد العتيد، وإنّ كلّ الأشياء تعمل معًا للخير للذين يحبّون الله.
الكاثوليكون (رسالة من رسائل يعقوب أو بطرس أو يوحنا أو يهوذا) (1 بطرس 3: 8–15): هنا يقول القدّيس بطرس للمسيحيّين أن يكونوا متّحدي الرأي، وأن يباركوا بدل المجازاة، وأن يستعدّوا لشرح رجائهم بوداعة.
الإبركسيس (قراءة من سفر أعمال الرسل) (اعمال 19: 23–41): هنا يروي القدّيس لوقا كيف هدّأ كاتب المدينة الشغب الذي قام في أفسس بسبب أرطاميس، وصرف الجمع.
مزمور القداس (مزامير 68: 35، 3): هنا يدعو داود النبيّ الله أن يقوم، ويسبّحه الصاعد إلى العلاء بالظفر، ويدعو ممالك الأرض إلى الترنيم له.
إنجيل القداس (لوقا 12: 4–12): هنا يقول الربّ يسوع لأحبّائه ألّا يخافوا من الذين يقتلون الجسد، وأن يعترفوا به قدّام الناس، وأن يتّكلوا على الروح القدس.

Jesus says, "Do not be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do." Five sparrows are sold for two copper coins, yet not one is forgotten by God; "the very hairs of your head are all numbered." Whoever confesses Him before people will be confessed before the angels of God, and the Holy Spirit will teach us what to say when we are put on trial.

Romans 8 says that "the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us", that all creation groans waiting for redemption, and that "all things work together for good to those who love God." Pain is real, but it is not the last word.

مزمور القداس (مزامير 68: 35، 3): هنا يدعو داود النبيّ الله أن يقوم، ويسبّحه الصاعد إلى العلاء بالظفر، ويدعو ممالك الأرض إلى الترنيم له.
إنجيل القداس (لوقا 12: 4–12): هنا يقول الربّ يسوع لأحبّائه ألّا يخافوا من الذين يقتلون الجسد، وأن يعترفوا به قدّام الناس، وأن يتّكلوا على الروح القدس.

يقول يسوع: «لا تخافوا من الذين يقتلون الجسد، وبعد ذلك ليس لهم ما يفعلون أكثر». خمسة عصافير تُباع بفلسين، ومع ذلك لا يُنسى واحد منها أمام الله؛ «بل شعور رؤوسكم أيضًا جميعها محصاة». ومن يعترف به قدام الناس يُعترف به قدام ملائكة الله، والروح القدس يعلّمنا ماذا نقول حين نُحاكَم.

ويقول الأصحاح الثامن من رومية إن «آلام الزمان الحاضر لا تُقاس بالمجد العتيد أن يُستعلن فينا»، وإن الخليقة كلها تئنّ منتظرة الفداء، وإن «كل الأشياء تعمل معًا للخير للذين يحبون الله». الألم حقيقي، لكنه ليس الكلمة الأخيرة.

notes.en: Sparrows were the cheapest food in the market; Jesus uses them to show how much more God values us.
notes.ar: كانت العصافير أرخص طعام في السوق؛ ويستخدمها يسوع ليُظهر أن الله يقدّرنا أكثر بكثير.

saints.name_en: The Martyrdom of St. Macarius, the Son of Basilides (Wasilides) the Minister
saints.name_ar: أستشهاد القديس مكاريوس بن واسيليدِس الوزير

parts.en: On this day of the year 20 of the martyrs (304 A.D.) St. Macarius, the son of Basilides the Chancellor, was martyred. This saint was Christian from the city of Antioch of Syria. When they reviewed with Macarius the orders of Emperor Diocletian which dictated the worship of idols, he did not heed them. When the Emperor knew that, he issued an order to exile him to Alexandria. He bid farewell to his mother and asked her to care for the poor and the needy. On the way, the Lord Christ appeared to him in a nightly vision, strengthened and encouraged him, and told him what would happen to him. When he arrived to Alexandria, he stood before Armanius the governor and confessed the Lord Christ before him. He deceitfully treated him well because he knew that he was the son of Basilides the Chancellor. When Macarius refused his promises, the Governor tormented him with all kinds of tortures.
parts.ar: في هذا اليوم من سنة 20 للشهداء (304م) استشهد القديس مكاريوس بن واسيليدِس الوزير. كان هذا القديس مسيحياً من مدينة أنطاكية في سوريا. ولما عرضوا عليه أوامر الإمبراطور دقلديانوس التي تقضي بعبادة الأوثان، لم يوافق عليها. فوصلت أخباره لمسامع الإمبراطور الذي أصدر أمراً بنفيه إلى الإسكندرية. وعند ذلك ودع أمه وأوصاها بالفقراء والمساكين. وفي الطريق ظهر له السيد المسيح في رؤيا الليل وقوَّاه وعزَّاه وأعلمه بما يناله. ولما وصل إلى الإسكندرية وقف أمام أرمانيوس الوالي واعترف بالسيد المسيح. فلاطفه الوالي لعلمه أنه ابن الوزير واسيليدِس، لكن لم يقبل القديس منه فعذبه الوالي بكل نوع.

parts.en: Afterwards, the Governor sent him to Nikios where he was tortured again. They cut off his tongue and arms and placed hot nails in his sides.
parts.ar: ثم أرسله إلى نقيوس حيث عذبوه هناك كثيراً وقطعوا لسانه وذراعَيه.

parts.en: God wrought many splendid miracles by the hands of this saint. Among these: One day a funeral procession passed by him and the saint asked the Lord Christ to reveal His glory, and the man rose from the dead instantly. The risen man told the people around him of what he saw in Hades, and that Christ is the Lord of all. Many believed, and were beheaded and received the crowns of martyrdom.
parts.ar: وصنع الله على يدَي هذا القديس معجزات باهرة. منها أن قوماً اجتازوا به حاملين ميتاً لهم. فطلب من السيد المسيح أن يظهر مجده. فقام الميت لوقته وأعلم الحاضرين بما رأى في الجحيم، وأن المسيح هو رب الكل. فآمن الجميع وقُطعت رؤوسهم ونالوا اكاليل الشهادة.

parts.en: It happened that Arianus the Governor of Antinoe (Ansena) was present in Alexandria and he took the saint with him on his way back to Ansena. When they arrived to Shatanof (Setnuf, Pshati), the ship stopped and they could not move it. The Governor ordered the soldiers to disembark the saint to the shore where they beheaded him thus he received the crown of martyrdom.
parts.ar: واتفق حضور أريانوس والي أنصنا، فأخذ القديس معه عند عودته. ولما وصلوا إلى شطانوف تعطلت المركب عن المسير فأمر الوالي الجند أن يُصعِدوه إلى الشاطئ ويقطعوا رأسه المقدسة، فنال إكليل الشهادة.

parts.en: When Emperor Constantine reigned, the Saint appeared to the commander Eulogius in a nightly vision and told him the whereabouts of his body. He took the body, built a church after his name where he placed the body. God had honored him by manifesting many miracles from his pure body.
parts.ar: ولما ملك قسطنطين البار ظهر هذا القديس في رؤيا الليل للأمير أولوجيوس وأعلمه بمكان جسده. فأخذه وبنى عليه كنيسة. وقد شرفه الله بظهور آيات من جسده الطاهر.

parts.en: The blessing of his prayers be with us all. Amen.
parts.ar: بركة صلواته فلتكن معنا. آمين.

parts.en: St Macarius, son of the chancellor Basilides of Antioch, ignored Diocletian's order to worship idols and was exiled to Alexandria. He asked his mother to care for the poor; on the way Christ appeared and strengthened him. He confessed Christ before the governor. Martyred in 304. He teaches caring for the poor even in trial.
parts.ar: لم يعبأ القديس مقاريوس بن واسيليدس الوزير الأنطاكي بأمر دقلديانوس بعبادة الأوثان، فنُفي إلى الإسكندرية. وأوصى أمه بالفقراء والمحتاجين؛ وفي الطريق ظهر له المسيح وقوّاه. واعترف بالمسيح أمام الوالي. واستشهد سنة 304م. يعلّمنا الاهتمام بالفقراء حتى في الضيق.

parts.en: Think of the needy even when you're struggling.
parts.ar: تذكّر المحتاجين حتى وأنت في ضيق.

saints.name_en: The Martyrdom of St. Leontius of Tripoli (Lawendius)

parts.en: On this day also of the year 19 of the martyrs (303 A.D.) St. Leontius of Tripoli (Lawendius) was martyred. This saint was born in the city of Tripoli in Syria to Christian parents. He was perfect in his conduct and gentle in his demeanor. He read continuously in the Holy Scriptures.
parts.ar: فيه أيضاً من سنة 19 للشهداء (303م) استشهد القديس لاونديوس. ولد هذا القديس في مدينة طرابلس بالشام من أبوَين مسيحيَين. وكان كاملاً في سيرته، لطيفاً بعشرته ومداوماً على قراءة الكتب الإلهية.

parts.en: When he enlisted in the army, he preached to his fellow soldiers and advised them to believe in the Lord Christ, the true God. The commander brought the saint to question him. The Saint replied saying: "Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril or sword?" (Romans 8:35)
parts.ar: ولما انتظم في سلك الجندية كان يعِظ رفاقه الجنود وينصحهم كي يؤمنوا بالسيد المسيح الإله الحقيقي. فأستحضره القائد وأستجوبه، فرد القديس قائلاً: "مَن سيفصلنا عن محبة المسيح؟ أشدةٌ أم ضيق أم اضطهاد أم جوع أم عري أم خطر أم سيف."

parts.en: The commander became enraged, and imprisoned the saint. The next day, he brought him back, and asked him, "With what power do you dare to disobey the orders of the Emperor, and drive the people away from worshiping the gods?" The Saint replied, "Truly I desire that all people come to know the Lord Christ and believe in Him. If you also abandon your error, and worship Christ you too will inherit the Heavenly Kingdom." The commander became angry and ordered to torture him severely until his blood poured out while he was praising God. Finally, St. Leontius delivered up his pure spirit while he was in prison and received the crown of martyrdom.
parts.ar: فغضب منه القائد وطرحه في السجن، ثم استحضره في اليوم التالي وقال له: "بأية قوة تتجرأ على مخالفة أمر الملك وترد الناس عن عبادة الآلهة؟" فأجابه القديس: "حقاً إني أود أن الناس جميعاً يعرفون السيد المسيح ويؤمنون به. وإذا أنتَ تركتَ عنكَ ضلالتكَ وعبدتَ المسيح ترثُ ملكوت السموات". فغضب القائد وعذبه كثيراً إلى أن جرى دمه وهو يسبح الله. وأخيراً فاضت روحه الطاهرة ونال إكليل الشهادة.

parts.en: A wealthy Christian woman, who was the wife of one of the commanders of Emperor Diocletian, took his pure body. She shrouded it, and put him in a coffin inside her home where she placed a lit lamp before him. God had delivered her husband from the tyrant hand of Diocletian with the prayers of this saint. After the end of the era of persecution they built a church after his name and relocated his body to it on the first day of Paone.
parts.ar: فأخذت امرأة مسيحية زوجة أحد قواد الإمبراطور دقلديانوس جسده الطاهر وكفنته ووضعته في صندوق داخل بيتها، ووضعت أمامه قنديلاً. وقد خلص الله زوجها من بطش دقلديانوس بصلوات هذا القديس. ولما انقضى زمن الاضطهاد بنوا كنيسة على اسمه ونقلوا الجسد إليها في أول بؤونة.

parts.en: The blessing of his prayers be with us all and glory be to our God for ever. Amen.
parts.ar: بركة صلواته فلتكن معنا. ولربنا المجد دائماً أبدياً. آمين.

parts.en: St Leontius of Tripoli, gentle and devoted to Scripture, preached Christ to fellow soldiers. Questioned by the commander, he answered, "Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution...?" and was imprisoned. Martyred in 303. He teaches answering with Scripture.
parts.ar: كان القديس لاونديوس الطرابلسي وديعًا مواظبًا على قراءة الكتب المقدسة، وبشّر رفاقه الجنود بالمسيح. ولما استجوبه القائد أجاب: «من سيفصلنا عن محبة المسيح؟ أشدة أم ضيق أم اضطهاد...؟» فسُجن. واستشهد سنة 303م. يعلّمنا الإجابة بالكتاب المقدس.

parts.en: Let Scripture shape your answers.
parts.ar: دع الكتاب المقدس يشكّل إجاباتك.

ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲙⲉⲩⲓ ϫⲉ ⲉⲧⲁⲓⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϩⲓⲟⲩⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲉⲧⲁⲓⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϩⲓⲟⲩⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲁⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲟⲩⲥⲏϥⲓ ⲁⲓⲓ̀ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉ̀ⲫⲉⲣϫ ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲩϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲥⲙⲁⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲩϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲥϣⲱⲙⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲉⲛϫⲁϫⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲉ ⲛⲉϥⲣⲉⲙⲛ̀ⲏⲓ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲑⲙⲉⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲓⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉⲣⲟⲓ ϥⲉⲙⲡϣⲁ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲓ ⲁⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲑⲙⲉⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲓⲉ ⲧⲉϥϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉⲣⲟⲓ ϥⲉⲙⲡϣⲁ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲓ ⲁⲛ ⲫⲏ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛ̀ϥⲛⲁⲱⲗⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲥⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ ⲁⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱⲓ ϥⲉⲙⲡϣⲁ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲓ ⲁⲛ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥϫⲓⲙⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲕⲟⲥ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲑⲛⲁⲧⲁⲕⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲉⲑⲃⲏⲧ ⲉϥⲉ̀ϫⲉⲙⲥ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧϣⲱⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲁϥϣⲱⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧϣⲱⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲓ ⲁϥϣⲱⲡ ⲙ̀ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲁⲟⲩⲟⲓ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧϣⲱⲡ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲡⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ ⲉ̀ⲫⲣⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲡⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ ⲉϥⲉ̀ϭⲓ ⲙ̀ⲫⲃⲉⲭⲉ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲡⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧϣⲱⲡ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲑⲙⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ⲫⲣⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲑⲙⲏⲓ ⲉϥⲉ̀ϭⲓ ⲙ̀ⲫⲃⲉⲭⲉ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲑⲙⲏⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲑⲛⲁⲧⲥⲉ ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲓⲕⲟⲩϫⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲫⲟⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ ϩⲱϫ ⲙⲟⲛⲟⲛ ⲉ̀ⲫⲣⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ ⲁⲙⲏⲛ ϯϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉϥⲧⲁⲕⲟ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲃⲉⲭⲉ

ϯϫⲱ ⲇⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲁϣⲫⲏⲣ ϫⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲉⲣϩⲟϯ ϧⲁⲧϩⲏ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏ ⲉⲑⲛⲁϧⲱⲧⲉⲃ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲧⲉⲛⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲁ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϩⲗⲓ ⲛ̀ϩⲟⲩⲟ ⲉ̀ⲁⲓϥ ϯⲛⲁⲧⲁⲙⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲇⲉ ϫⲉ ⲁⲣⲓϩⲟϯ ϧⲁⲧϩⲏ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲙ ⲁⲣⲓϩⲟϯ ϧⲁⲧϩⲏ ⲙ̀ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲉ ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲁ ⲉ̀ⲑⲣⲉϥϧⲱⲧⲉⲃ ⲟⲩⲟⲛⲧⲉϥ ⲉⲣϣⲓϣⲓ ⲉ̀ϩⲓⲟⲩⲓ ⲉ̀ϯⲅⲉⲉⲛⲛⲁ ⲁϩⲁ ϯϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϫⲉ ⲁⲣⲓϩⲟϯ ϧⲁⲧϩⲏ ⲙ̀ⲫⲁⲓ ⲙⲏ ⲉ̅ ⲛ̀ϭⲁϫ ⲁⲛ ⲉⲧⲟⲩϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲁ ⲧⲉⲃⲓ ⲥⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧⲟⲩ ⲥⲉⲟⲃϣ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲙ̀ⲫϯ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲛⲓⲕⲉϥⲱⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲁⲫⲉ ⲥⲉⲏⲡ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲉⲣϩⲟϯ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲟⲧ ⲉ̀ⲟⲩⲙⲏϣ ⲛ̀ϭⲁϫ ϯϫⲱ ⲇⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲑⲛⲁⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ϩⲱϥ ⲙ̀ⲫⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲁⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧϥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫϯ ⲫⲏ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲑⲛⲁϫⲟⲗⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲥⲉⲛⲁϫⲟⲗⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲱϥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫϯ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲑⲛⲁϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁ ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲫⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲥⲉⲛⲁⲭⲁϥ ⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲫⲏ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲑⲛⲁϫⲉⲟⲩⲁ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲭⲱ ⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲟⲧⲁⲛ ⲁⲩϣⲁⲛⲉⲛ ⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲥⲩⲛⲁⲅⲱⲅⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲉⲝⲟⲩⲥⲓⲁ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣϥⲓⲣⲱⲟⲩϣ ϫⲉ ⲡⲱⲥ ⲓⲉ ⲟⲩ ⲡⲉⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲓⲉ ⲟⲩ ⲡⲉⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁϫⲟϥ ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛⲁⲧⲥⲁⲃⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲉⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲛⲏ ⲉⲑⲛⲁⲥⲉⲙⲡϣⲁ ⲛ̀ϫⲟⲧⲟⲩ

items.en: The Martyrdom of St. Longinus the Soldier
The Martyrdom of St. Marina, of Antioch

readings.en: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble. The LORD of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge.Selah
readings.ar: ٱللهُ لَنَا مَلْجَأٌ وَقُوَّةٌ. عَوْنًا فِي ٱلضِّيْقَاتِ وُجِدَ شَدِيدًا. رَبُّ ٱلْجُنُودِ مَعَنَا. مَلْجَأُنَا إِلَهُ يَعْقُوبَ. سِلَاهْ.

readings.en: And as He walked by the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen. Then Jesus said to them, "Follow Me, and I will make you become fishers of men." They immediately left their nets and followed Him. When He had gone a little farther from there, He saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the boat mending their nets. And immediately He called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and went after Him. Then they went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath He entered the synagogue and taught. And they were astonished at His teaching, for He taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
readings.ar: وَفِيمَا هُوَ يَمْشِي عِنْدَ بَحْرِ ٱلْجَلِيلِ أَبْصَرَ سِمْعَانَ وَأَنْدَرَاوُسَ أَخَاهُ يُلْقِيَانِ شَبَكَةً فِي ٱلْبَحْرِ، فَإِنَّهُمَا كَانَا صَيَّادَيْنِ. فَقَالَ لَهُمَا يَسُوعُ: «هَلُمَّ وَرَائِي فَأَجْعَلُكُمَا تَصِيرَانِ صَيَّادَيِ ٱلنَّاسِ». فَلِلْوَقْتِ تَرَكَا شِبَاكَهُمَا وَتَبِعَاهُ. ثُمَّ ٱجْتَازَ مِنْ هُنَاكَ قَلِيلًا فَرَأَى يَعْقُوبَ بْنَ زَبْدِي وَيُوحَنَّا أَخَاهُ، وَهُمَا فِي ٱلسَّفِينَةِ يُصْلِحَانِ ٱلشِّبَاكَ. فَدَعَاهُمَا لِلْوَقْتِ. فَتَرَكَا أَبَاهُمَا زَبْدِي فِي ٱلسَّفِينَةِ مَعَ ٱلْأَجْرَى وَذَهَبَا وَرَاءَهُ. ثُمَّ دَخَلُوا كَفْرَنَاحُومَ، وَلِلْوَقْتِ دَخَلَ ٱلْمَجْمَعَ فِي ٱلسَّبْتِ وَصَارَ يُعَلِّمُ. فَبُهِتُوا مِنْ تَعْلِيمِهِ لِأَنَّهُ كَانَ يُعَلِّمُهُمْ كَمَنْ لَهُ سُلْطَانٌ وَلَيْسَ كَٱلْكَتَبَةِ.

readings.en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, O my soul! Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in the LORD his God,
readings.ar: هَلِّلُويَا. سَبِّحِي يَا نَفْسِي ٱلرَّبَّ. طُوبَى لِمَنْ إِلَهُ يَعْقُوبَ مُعِينُهُ، وَرَجَاؤُهُ عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِهِ،

readings.en: And Jesus, walking by the Sea of Galilee, saw two brothers, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen. Then He said to them, "Follow Me, and I will make you fishers of men." They immediately left their nets and followed Him. Going on from there, He saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them, and immediately they left the boat and their father, and followed Him.
readings.ar: وَإِذْ كَانَ يَسُوعُ مَاشِيًا عِنْدَ بَحْرِ ٱلْجَلِيلِ أَبْصَرَ أَخَوَيْنِ: سِمْعَانَ ٱلَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ بُطْرُسُ، وَأَنْدَرَاوُسَ أَخَاهُ يُلْقِيَانِ شَبَكَةً فِي ٱلْبَحْرِ، فَإِنَّهُمَا كَانَا صَيَّادَيْنِ. فَقَالَ لَهُمَا: «هَلُمَّ وَرَائِي فَأَجْعَلُكُمَا صَيَّادَيِ ٱلنَّاسِ». فَلِلْوَقْتِ تَرَكَا ٱلشِّبَاكَ وَتَبِعَاهُ. ثُمَّ ٱجْتَازَ مِنْ هُنَاكَ فَرَأَى أَخَوَيْنِ آخَرَيْنِ: يَعْقُوبَ بْنَ زَبْدِي وَيُوحَنَّا أَخَاهُ، فِي ٱلسَّفِينَةِ مَعَ زَبْدِي أَبِيهِمَا يُصْلِحَانِ شِبَاكَهُمَا، فَدَعَاهُمَا. فَلِلْوَقْتِ تَرَكَا ٱلسَّفِينَةَ وَأَبَاهُمَا وَتَبِعَاهُ.

readings.en: Paul, an apostle (not from men nor through man, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father who raised Him from the dead), and all the brethren who are with me, To the churches of Galatia: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ, who gave Himself for our sins, that He might deliver us from this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen. I marvel that you are turning away so soon from Him who called you in the grace of Christ, to a different gospel, which is not another; but there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the gospel of Christ. But even if we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel to you than what we have preached to you, let him be accursed. As we have said before, so now I say again, if anyone preaches any other gospel to you than what you have received, let him be accursed. For do I now persuade men, or God? Or do I seek to please men? For if I still pleased men, I would not be a bondservant of Christ. But I make known to you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached by me is not according to man. For I neither received it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came through the revelation of Jesus Christ. For you have heard of my former conduct in Judaism, how I persecuted the church of God beyond measure and tried to destroy it. And I advanced in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries in my own nation, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers. But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb and called me through His grace, to reveal His Son in me, that I might preach Him among the Gentiles, I did not immediately confer with flesh and blood, nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me; but I went to Arabia, and returned again to Damascus. Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and remained with him fifteen days. But I saw none of the other apostles except James, the Lord's brother.
readings.ar: بُولُسُ، رَسُولٌ لَا مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَا بِإِنْسَانٍ، بَلْ بِيَسُوعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ وَٱللهِ ٱلْآبِ ٱلَّذِي أَقَامَهُ مِنَ ٱلْأَمْوَاتِ، وَجَمِيعُ ٱلْإِخْوَةِ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعِي، إِلَى كَنَائِسِ غَلَاطِيَّةَ: نِعْمَةٌ لَكُمْ وَسَلَامٌ مِنَ ٱللهِ ٱلْآبِ، وَمِنْ رَبِّنَا يَسُوعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ، ٱلَّذِي بَذَلَ نَفْسَهُ لِأَجْلِ خَطَايَانَا، لِيُنْقِذَنَا مِنَ ٱلْعَالَمِ ٱلْحَاضِرِ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ حَسَبَ إِرَادَةِ ٱللهِ وَأَبِينَا، ٱلَّذِي لَهُ ٱلْمَجْدُ إِلَى أَبَدِ ٱلْآبِدِينَ. آمِينَ. إِنِّي أَتَعَجَّبُ أَنَّكُمْ تَنْتَقِلُونَ هَكَذَا سَرِيعًا عَنِ ٱلَّذِي دَعَاكُمْ بِنِعْمَةِ ٱلْمَسِيحِ إِلَى إِنْجِيلٍ آخَرَ! لَيْسَ هُوَ آخَرَ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يُوجَدُ قَوْمٌ يُزْعِجُونَكُمْ وَيُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُحَوِّلُوا إِنْجِيلَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ. وَلَكِنْ إِنْ بَشَّرْنَاكُمْ نَحْنُ أَوْ مَلَاكٌ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ بِغَيْرِ مَا بَشَّرْنَاكُمْ، فَلْيَكُنْ «أَنَاثِيمَا»! كَمَا سَبَقْنَا فَقُلْنَا أَقُولُ ٱلْآنَ أَيْضًا: إِنْ كَانَ أَحَدٌ يُبَشِّرُكُمْ بِغَيْرِ مَا قَبِلْتُمْ، فَلْيَكُنْ «أَنَاثِيمَا»! أَفَأَسْتَعْطِفُ ٱلْآنَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَمِ ٱللهَ؟ أَمْ أَطْلُبُ أَنْ أُرْضِيَ ٱلنَّاسَ؟ فَلَوْ كُنْتُ بَعْدُ أُرْضِي ٱلنَّاسَ، لَمْ أَكُنْ عَبْدًا لِلْمَسِيحِ. وَأُعَرِّفُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْإِخْوَةُ ٱلْإِنْجِيلَ ٱلَّذِي بَشَّرْتُ بِهِ، أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِحَسَبِ إِنْسَانٍ. لِأَنِّي لَمْ أَقْبَلْهُ مِنْ عِنْدِ إِنْسَانٍ وَلَا عُلِّمْتُهُ. بَلْ بِإِعْلَانِ يَسُوعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ. فَإِنَّكُمْ سَمِعْتُمْ بِسِيرَتِي قَبْلًا فِي ٱلدِّيَانَةِ ٱلْيَهُودِيَّةِ، أَنِّي كُنْتُ أَضْطَهِدُ كَنِيسَةَ ٱللهِ بِإِفْرَاطٍ وَأُتْلِفُهَا. وَكُنْتُ أَتَقَدَّمُ فِي ٱلدِّيَانَةِ ٱلْيَهُودِيَّةِ عَلَى كَثِيرِينَ مِنْ أَتْرَابِي فِي جِنْسِي، إِذْ كُنْتُ أَوْفَرَ غَيْرَةً فِي تَقْلِيدَاتِ آبَائِي. وَلَكِنْ لَمَّا سَرَّ ٱللهَ ٱلَّذِي أَفْرَزَنِي مِنْ بَطْنِ أُمِّي، وَدَعَانِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ، أَنْ يُعْلِنَ ٱبْنَهُ فِيَّ لِأُبَشِّرَ بِهِ بَيْنَ ٱلْأُمَمِ، لِلْوَقْتِ لَمْ أَسْتَشِرْ لَحْمًا وَدَمًا، وَلَا صَعِدْتُ إِلَى أُورُشَلِيمَ، إِلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ ٱلَّذِينَ قَبْلِي، بَلِ ٱنْطَلَقْتُ إِلَى ٱلْعَرَبِيَّةِ، ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ أَيْضًا إِلَى دِمَشْقَ. ثُمَّ بَعْدَ ثَلَاثِ سِنِينَ صَعِدْتُ إِلَى أُورُشَلِيمَ لِأَتَعَرَّفَ بِبُطْرُسَ، فَمَكَثْتُ عِنْدَهُ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْمًا. وَلَكِنَّنِي لَمْ أَرَ غَيْرَهُ مِنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا يَعْقُوبَ أَخَا ٱلرَّبِّ.

readings.en: James, a bondservant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad: Greetings. My brethren, count it all joy when you fall into various trials, knowing that the testing of your faith produces patience. But let patience have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking nothing. If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him. But let him ask in faith, with no doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea driven and tossed by the wind. For let not that man suppose that he will receive anything from the Lord; he is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways. Let the lowly brother glory in his exaltation, but the rich in his humiliation, because as a flower of the field he will pass away. For no sooner has the sun risen with a burning heat than it withers the grass; its flower falls, and its beautiful appearance perishes. So the rich man also will fade away in his pursuits. Blessed is the man who endures temptation; for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord has promised to those who love Him.
readings.ar: يَعْقُوبُ، عَبْدُ ٱللهِ وَٱلرَّبِّ يَسُوعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ، يُهْدِي ٱلسَّلَامَ إِلَى ٱلِٱثْنَيْ عَشَرَ سِبْطًا ٱلَّذِينَ فِي ٱلشَّتَاتِ. اِحْسِبُوهُ كُلَّ فَرَحٍ يَا إِخْوَتِي حِينَمَا تَقَعُونَ فِي تَجَارِبَ مُتَنَوِّعَةٍ، عَالِمِينَ أَنَّ ٱمْتِحَانَ إِيمَانِكُمْ يُنْشِئُ صَبْرًا. وَأَمَّا ٱلصَّبْرُ فَلْيَكُنْ لَهُ عَمَلٌ تَامٌّ، لِكَيْ تَكُونُوا تَامِّينَ وَكَامِلِينَ غَيْرَ نَاقِصِينَ فِي شَيْءٍ. وَإِنَّمَا إِنْ كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ تُعْوِزُهُ حِكْمَةٌ، فَلْيَطْلُبْ مِنَ ٱللهِ ٱلَّذِي يُعْطِي ٱلْجَمِيعَ بِسَخَاءٍ وَلَا يُعَيِّرُ، فَسَيُعْطَى لَهُ. وَلَكِنْ لِيَطْلُبْ بِإِيمَانٍ غَيْرَ مُرْتَابٍ ٱلْبَتَّةَ، لِأَنَّ ٱلْمُرْتَابَ يُشْبِهُ مَوْجًا مِنَ ٱلْبَحْرِ تَخْبِطُهُ ٱلرِّيحُ وَتَدْفَعُهُ. فَلَا يَظُنَّ ذَلِكَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ أَنَّهُ يَنَالُ شَيْئًا مِنْ عِنْدِ ٱلرَّبِّ. رَجُلٌ ذُو رَأْيَيْنِ هُوَ مُتَقَلْقِلٌ فِي جَمِيعِ طُرُقِهِ. وَلْيَفْتَخِرِ ٱلْأَخُ ٱلْمُتَّضِعُ بِٱرْتِفَاعِهِ، وَأَمَّا ٱلْغَنِيُّ فَبِٱتِّضَاعِهِ، لِأَنَّهُ كَزَهْرِ ٱلْعُشْبِ يَزُولُ. لِأَنَّ ٱلشَّمْسَ أَشْرَقَتْ بِٱلْحَرِّ، فَيَبَّسَتِ ٱلْعُشْبَ، فَسَقَطَ زَهْرُهُ وَفَنِيَ جَمَالُ مَنْظَرِهِ. هَكَذَا يَذْبُلُ ٱلْغَنِيُّ أَيْضًا فِي طُرُقِهِ. طُوبَى لِلرَّجُلِ ٱلَّذِي يَحْتَمِلُ ٱلتَّجْرِبَةَ، لِأَنَّهُ إِذَا تَزَكَّى يَنَالُ «إِكْلِيلَ ٱلْحَيَاةِ» ٱلَّذِي وَعَدَ بِهِ ٱلرَّبُّ لِلَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَهُ.

readings.en: And after they had become silent, James answered, saying, "Men and brethren, listen to me: Simon has declared how God at the first visited the Gentiles to take out of them a people for His name. And with this the words of the prophets agree, just as it is written: 'After this I will return And will rebuild the tabernacle of David, which has fallen down; I will rebuild its ruins, And I will set it up; So that the rest of mankind may seek the LORD, Even all the Gentiles who are called by My name, Says the LORD who does all these things.' "Known to God from eternity are all His works. Therefore I judge that we should not trouble those from among the Gentiles who are turning to God, but that we write to them to abstain from things polluted by idols, from sexual immorality, from things strangled, and from blood. For Moses has had throughout many generations those who preach him in every city, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath."
readings.ar: وَبَعْدَمَا سَكَتَا أَجَابَ يَعْقُوبُ قَائِلًا: «أَيُّهَا ٱلرِّجَالُ ٱلْإِخْوَةُ، ٱسْمَعُونِي. سِمْعَانُ قَدْ أَخْبَرَ كَيْفَ ٱفْتَقَدَ ٱللهُ أَوَّلًا ٱلْأُمَمَ لِيَأْخُذَ مِنْهُمْ شَعْبًا عَلَى ٱسْمِهِ. وَهَذَا تُوافِقُهُ أَقْوَالُ ٱلْأَنْبِيَاءِ، كَمَا هُوَ مَكْتُوبٌ: سَأَرْجِعُ بَعْدَ هَذَا وَأَبْنِي أَيْضًا خَيْمَةَ دَاوُدَ ٱلسَّاقِطَةَ، وَأَبْنِي أَيْضًا رَدْمَهَا وَأُقِيمُهَا ثَانِيَةً، لِكَيْ يَطْلُبَ ٱلْبَاقُونَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ٱلرَّبَّ، وَجَمِيعُ ٱلْأُمَمِ ٱلَّذِينَ دُعِيَ ٱسْمِي عَلَيْهِمْ، يَقُولُ ٱلرَّبُّ ٱلصَّانِعُ هَذَا كُلَّهُ. مَعْلُومَةٌ عِنْدَ ٱلرَّبِّ مُنْذُ ٱلْأَزَلِ جَمِيعُ أَعْمَالِهِ. لِذَلِكَ أَنَا أَرَى أَنْ لَا يُثَقَّلَ عَلَى ٱلرَّاجِعِينَ إِلَى ٱللهِ مِنَ ٱلْأُمَمِ، بَلْ يُرْسَلْ إِلَيْهِمْ أَنْ يَمْتَنِعُوا عَنْ نَجَاسَاتِ ٱلْأَصْنَامِ، وَٱلزِّنَا، وَٱلْمَخْنُوقِ، وَٱلدَّمِ. لِأَنَّ مُوسَى مُنْذُ أَجْيَالٍ قَدِيمَةٍ، لَهُ فِي كُلِّ مَدِينَةٍ مَنْ يَكْرِزُ بِهِ، إِذْ يُقْرَأُ فِي ٱلْمَجَامِعِ كُلَّ سَبْتٍ».

readings.en: For He established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which He commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children; For I know that the LORD is great, And our Lord is above all gods.
readings.ar: أَقَامَ شَهَادَةً فِي يَعْقُوبَ، وَوَضَعَ شَرِيعَةً فِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، ٱلَّتِي أَوْصَى آبَاءَنَا أَنْ يُعَرِّفُوا بِهَا أَبْنَاءَهُمْ، لِأَنِّي أَنَا قَدْ عَرَفْتُ أَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ عَظِيمٌ، وَرَبَّنَا فَوْقَ جَمِيعِٱلْآلِهَةِ.

readings.en: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Him, saying, "Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask." And He said to them, "What do you want Me to do for you?" They said to Him, "Grant us that we may sit, one on Your right hand and the other on Your left, in Your glory." But Jesus said to them, "You do not know what you ask. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?" They said to Him, "We are able." So Jesus said to them, "You will indeed drink the cup that I drink, and with the baptism I am baptized with you will be baptized; but to sit on My right hand and on My left is not Mine to give, but it is for those for whom it is prepared." And when the ten heard it, they began to be greatly displeased with James and John. But Jesus called them to Himself and said to them, "You know that those who are considered rulers over the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them. Yet it shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant. And whoever of you desires to be first shall be slave of all. For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life a ransom for many."
readings.ar: وَتَقَدَّمَ إِلَيْهِ يَعْقُوبُ وَيُوحَنَّا ٱبْنَا زَبْدِي قَائِلَيْنِ: «يَا مُعَلِّمُ، نُرِيدُ أَنْ تَفْعَلَ لَنَا كُلَّ مَا طَلَبْنَا». فَقَالَ لَهُمَا: «مَاذَا تُرِيدَانِ أَنْ أَفْعَلَ لَكُمَا؟». فَقَالَا لَهُ: «أَعْطِنَا أَنْ نَجْلِسَ وَاحِدٌ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ وَٱلْآخَرُ عَنْ يَسَارِكَ فِي مَجْدِكَ». فَقَالَ لَهُمَا يَسُوعُ: «لَسْتُمَا تَعْلَمَانِ مَا تَطْلُبَانِ. أَتَسْتَطِيعَانِ أَنْ تَشْرَبَا ٱلْكَأْسَ ٱلَّتِي أَشْرَبُهَا أَنَا، وَأَنْ تَصْطَبِغَا بِٱلصِّبْغَةِ ٱلَّتِي أَصْطَبغُ بِهَا أَنَا؟» فَقَالَا لَهُ: «نَسْتَطِيعُ». فَقَالَ لَهُمَا يَسُوعُ: «أَمَّا ٱلْكَأْسُ ٱلَّتِي أَشْرَبُهَا أَنَا فَتَشْرَبَانِهَا، وَبَالصِّبْغَةِ ٱلَّتِي أَصْطَبِغُ بِهَا أَنَا تَصْطَبِغَانِ. وَأَمَّا ٱلْجُلُوسُ عَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ يَسَارِي فَلَيْسَ لِي أَنْ أُعْطِيَهُ إِلَّا لِلَّذِينَ أُعِدَّ لَهُمْ». وَلَمَّا سَمِعَ ٱلْعَشَرَةُ ٱبْتَدَأُوا يَغْتَاظُونَ مِنْ أَجْلِ يَعْقُوبَ وَيُوحَنَّا. فَدَعَاهُمْ يَسُوعُ وَقَالَ لَهُمْ: «أَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْسَبُونَ رُؤَسَاءَ ٱلْأُمَمِ يَسُودُونَهُمْ، وَأَنَّ عُظَمَاءَهُمْ يَتَسَلَّطُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ. فَلَا يَكُونُ هَكَذَا فِيكُمْ. بَلْ مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَصِيرَ فِيكُمْ عَظِيمًا، يَكُونُ لَكُمْ خَادِمًا، وَمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَصِيرَ فِيكُمْ أَوَّلًا، يَكُونُ لِلْجَمِيعِ عَبْدًا. لِأَنَّ ٱبْنَ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ أَيْضًا لَمْ يَأْتِ لِيُخْدَمَ بَلْ لِيَخْدِمَ وَلِيَبْذِلَ نَفْسَهُ فِدْيَةً عَنْ كَثِيرِينَ».

days.intro_en:
Vespers Psalm (read at the evening prayer service) (Psalm 46:1,7): Here the sons of Korah declare that God is our refuge and strength, the Lord of hosts who is with us.
Vespers Gospel (Mark 1:16–22): Here St Mark tells how the Lord Jesus calls the fishermen Simon and Andrew, James and John, and then teaches with authority in the synagogue (a Jewish house of prayer and teaching) at Capernaum.
Matins Psalm (read at the morning prayer service) (Psalm 146:1,5): Here the psalmist tells his soul to praise the Lord, and the people not to trust in princes but in God who helps the oppressed.
Matins Gospel (Matthew 4:18–22): Here the Lord Jesus, walking by the Sea of Galilee, calls the brothers Peter and Andrew, and James and John, to follow Him.
Pauline Epistle (a letter written by St Paul) (Galatians 1:1–19): Here St Paul tells the Galatians that his Gospel came by revelation of Jesus Christ, and recounts his former life and conversion.
Catholic Epistle (a letter to all churches by James, Peter, John or Jude) (James 1:1–12): Here St James writes to the twelve tribes scattered abroad, the Jewish Christians, telling them to count trials as joy and to ask God for wisdom.
Praxis (the reading from the Acts of the Apostles) (Acts 15:13–21): Here St James tells the council that the Gentiles (people who are not Jewish) turning to God fulfils the prophets, and proposes they abstain only from a few things.
Liturgy Psalm (read at the Liturgy, the service of Holy Communion) (Psalm 78:5; 135:5): Here Asaph tells the people the story of God's works for Israel and their unfaithfulness, until He chose David to shepherd them.
Liturgy Gospel (Mark 10:35–45): Here James and John ask the Lord Jesus for places at His right and left, and He teaches the twelve that He came to serve and give His life as a ransom.
days.intro_ar:
مزمور العشية (مزامير 46: 1، 7): هنا يعلن بنو قورح أنّ الله ملجأنا وقوّتنا، ربّ الجنود الذي معنا.
إنجيل العشية (مرقس 1: 16–22): هنا يروي القدّيس مرقس كيف دعا الربّ يسوع الصيّادين سمعان وأندراوس ويعقوب ويوحنا، ثمّ علّم بسلطان في مجمع كفرناحوم.
مزمور باكر (مزامير 146: 1، 5): هنا يقول صاحب المزمور لنفسه أن تسبّح الربّ، وللشعب ألّا يتّكلوا على الرؤساء بل على الله الذي يعين المظلومين.
إنجيل باكر (متى 4: 18–22): هنا يدعو الربّ يسوع، ماشيًا عند بحر الجليل، الأخوين بطرس وأندراوس، ويعقوب ويوحنا، ليتبعوه.
البولس (رسالة من رسائل القدّيس بولس) (غلاطية 1: 1–19): هنا يقول القدّيس بولس لأهل غلاطية إنّ إنجيله جاءه بإعلان يسوع المسيح، ويروي سيرته السابقة واهتداءه.
الكاثوليكون (رسالة من رسائل يعقوب أو بطرس أو يوحنا أو يهوذا) (يعقوب 1: 1–12): هنا يكتب القدّيس يعقوب إلى الأسباط الاثني عشر الذين في الشتات، المسيحيّين من اليهود، قائلًا لهم أن يحسبوا التجارب فرحًا ويطلبوا الحكمة من الله.
الإبركسيس (قراءة من سفر أعمال الرسل) (اعمال 15: 13–21): هنا يقول القدّيس يعقوب للمجمع إنّ رجوع الأمم إلى الله يتمّم الأنبياء، ويقترح أن يمتنعوا عن أمور قليلة فقط.
مزمور القداس (مزامير 78: 5؛ 135: 5): هنا يروي آساف للشعب قصّة أعمال الله لإسرائيل وعدم أمانتهم، حتّى اختار داود ليرعاهم.
إنجيل القداس (مرقس 10: 35–45): هنا يطلب يعقوب ويوحنا من الربّ يسوع أن يجلسا عن يمينه ويساره، فيعلّم الاثني عشر أنّه جاء ليخدم ويبذل نفسه فدية.

James and John ask to sit at Jesus' right and left in His glory. Jesus answers that among His followers greatness means service: "whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant." He Himself "did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life a ransom for many."

In Galatians Paul tells how Christ called him by grace, turning a persecutor of the Church into an apostle. Paul did not become an apostle by his own plans, but because God revealed His Son in him. The saints we remember today served quietly and faithfully. Look for one small way to serve someone today without being asked.
